decision: Founder decision D11 (2026-10-26): honua-release platform publication tags are signed keyless with gitsign by promote.yml's GitHub Actions OIDC identity on trunk. No signing key exists to nominate, hold or rotate.
statement: A qualified publication tag is an annotated tag object whose signature verifies against a signer named here: a Sigstore keyless workflow identity (gitsign) or a key fingerprint. GitHub required_signatures verifies commits, ruleset update/deletion rules give immutability, and gh release create writes a lightweight tag; none of the three is a signed tag.
key_material: gitsign signers are keyless: the policy names the exact Fulcio certificate identity (the signing workflow) and OIDC issuer, and gitsign verify-tag checks both plus the Rekor entry. ssh/openpgp signers are named by fingerprint only; their public keys live in an operator-supplied allowed-signers file that is never committed, and tools/tag_signing.py refuses any principal in that file whose fingerprint is absent here.
blocked_on: geospatial-grpc, honua-helm, honua-sdk-dotnet and honua-sdk-python still nominate no signer; their native publication tags cannot be produced or trusted until each repository's tag-creating workflow is given a keyless identity here.

geospatial-grpc.qualification: native protocol releases; signer not nominated

honua-helm.qualification: native chart releases; signer not nominated

honua-release.qualification: platform publication tags. publication-tag names the GA tag (honua-2026.1.0 for 2026.1-rc.N, honua-2026.1.Z for 2026.1.Z-rc.N). promote.yml signs that annotated tag with gitsign at the certified commit after release-promotion approval, pushes it, then verifies the published tag with gitsign verify-tag against this identity before creating the Release.

honua-sdk-dotnet.qualification: native NuGet releases; signer not nominated

honua-sdk-python.qualification: native wheel releases; signer not nominated
